name: Alpaca paper trading
rate_limits: Not stated on the paper trading page.
history_start: Not applicable (trading venue). Paper accounts get IEX market data.
what_it_has: A free paper account open to anyone with an email, starting at 100,000 virtual dollars, for US stocks and crypto. No forex.
simple: A pretend stock account where a program can practice buying and selling with fake money.
license_terms: Paper only accounts may only use IEX market data. Standard Alpaca terms apply. https://docs.alpaca.markets/docs/paper-trading
quality_notes: Fills ignore market impact, slippage, dividends and fees, and get random partial fills 10 percent of the time. FX is listed only as on the roadmap.

relevance.reason: Good for paper trading the S&P 500 benchmark through an ETF, but no FX.
